Seven Held for Suspected Mob Lynching in Palakkad, Kerala

Seven youths have been apprehended in connection with the suspected mob lynching of an unidentified man in Palakkad, Kerala. The incident involved the death of an unknown individual, and authorities have taken seven young men into custody.
